title: A Ruelle-McMullen formula for the volume dimension of skew products in $\mathbb C^2$
summary: Ruelle gave an explicit second-order expansion at $c=0$ of the Hausdorff dimension of the Julia set of the quadratic family $f_c(z)=z^2+c$. McMullen later extended this result to polynomial perturbations of $z^d$ for arbitrary degree $d\geq 2$. In this paper we study an analogue of this problem for skew products in $\mathbb C^2$. Since holomorphic dynamical systems in higher dimensions are non-conformal, we replace the Hausdorff dimension by the \emph{volume dimension}, a dynamically defined notion we introduced in our earlier work and characterized as the zero of a natural pressure…
